name: Emilia Regina
story: Emilia Regina was an enslaved woman of West African descent living on the Constitution Hill plantation on St. Croix, owned by the Danish colonial administrator Heinrich Ludvig Ernst von Schimmelmann. She is the mother of Hans Jonathan, who would later become famous for escaping enslavement by fleeing to Iceland. Through her lineage, her descendants became part of Icelandic and European history.
notes: Birth and death years are approximate based on historical context. She gave birth to Hans Jonathan in 1784.
